reason: E1 directly states that oxide film formation and rupture cause adhesive/abrasive wear, and that galvanic corrosion arises from potential differences between FCC and σ phases. However, E1 does not provide evidence for the cyclic coupling of these mechanisms (repeated rupture exposing fresh metal to galvanic attack) or their synergistic acceleration at elevated temperature, which are central to the hypothesis.
premises: Oxide film forms on CoCrFeNiMo HEA surface during high-speed friction
Rupture of this oxide film leads to adhesive and abrasive wear
Galvanic corrosion occurs between FCC and σ phases due to potential difference
These mechanisms (oxide rupture wear + galvanic corrosion) can operate concurrently
